statistics.checkpoint: median>1 and lower95>1+noise; no fixed minimum gain
statistics.five_percent: each required block median>=1.05 and lower95>max(1.05,1+noise)
statistics.unmatched_rows: Preserve every raw row and its metrics, flags and reasons. Declare structurally unmatched rows ineligible for the paired estimator before seeing timing; never match across epochs. Report their count and standalone metrics alongside primary results.
statistics.interrupted_controls: A partial control group remains incomplete with all rows retained. A new epoch requires a new complete control group. A completed failed control cannot be retried; it makes that context inconclusive for this pass.
statistics.resumed_block: Retain all complete same-epoch pairs from earlier epochs. Obtain fresh passing controls and symmetric candidate-block warmups before adding pairs. Assign new global pair IDs to abandoned pairs; stop at20completepairs, within global limits. Never replace a complete pair or select a subset based on performance/paging.
statistics.aa_failed_pairs: Retain comparison pairs from failed-control epochs and report them. They cannot support a gain; a failed control makes the full context inconclusive rather than permitting selection of passing epochs.

environment.global_paging_attribution: System-wide counters do not identify model pages; report counts/rates, pressure, allocator/process observations and prefill/decode separately.
environment.claim_scope: Under the recorded desktop workload, including Safari and observed paging, with the declared recovery schedule. No isolated-machine or sustained-throughput claim.

durability.start: Persist and fsync unique conservative start-slot reservations before model work, including primers, traces, diagnostics and warmups. Reserve both primer and measured-call slots as one collection before the primer. An unused or orphaned slot remains charged, with actual execution reported separately. One GPU request executes at a time; reserved slots are not concurrent execution.
durability.result: After GPU drain and observations, write a uniquely named temporary artifact with no-overwrite semantics, fsync it, publish it to a unique final name without replacing existing evidence, and fsync the parent directory. Append/fsync its content hash to the journal only after publication. Never write evidence inside a timed interval or between a primer and its measured request.
durability.primer_and_measured_commit: Reserve both call slots before running the primer. Keep the primer output in memory and start measurement without a journal fsync, artifact serialization or weight exchange between the two calls. Passive boundary telemetry stays declared and symmetric. Persist both result artifacts after measurement. If interrupted before commit, persist any completed in-memory results during drained cleanup when available, retain all reservations as charged and mark missing results explicitly; never reconstruct missing timings.
durability.journal: Append-only canonical JSON hash chain with writer lock and expected-sequence compare. Fsync records; reject stale controllers, altered chains and torn records. Hash-chain integrity does not substitute for an external frozen identity manifest.
durability.pause: Stop after the active GPU request drains, persist its evidence, close the epoch with complete source/checkpoint guards and budget receipts, then close worker/caffeinate. Do not start an extra primer/request to complete a pair.
durability.resume: Only explicit user-pause closure permits reopening under the same frozen identities and remaining global budgets. Revalidate the internal model receipt, actual vocabulary words, controller/candidate sources and environment; run a fresh8outputhandoff and fresh context controls. No automatic restart.
durability.hard_stop: Terminal for this pass. Preserve completed context certificates that were finalized with valid guards before the stop, with their narrower evidence scope. Do not automatically reopen the pass or claim the full goal.
durability.crash_or_torn_record: Fail closed. Preserve original journal bytes, raw artifacts and start reservations. An unresolved crash cannot be resumed or silently truncated into a successful record. Any future recovery needs a separate explicit record and must account for every reserved start.
durability.active_wall: Count all worker time, including model load, qualification, cooldown, telemetry, serialization and final cleanup. Sum immutable per-epoch monotonic elapsed receipts. Exclude only intervals after a verified user-pause closure and verified process exit. Retain UTC start/end times; clock regression or unresolved epoch-duration evidence fails closed. The7daycalendar bound includes pauses.
durability.bounds_enforcement: Check global starts and active/calendar/worker wall before reservations and at periodic watchdog checkpoints. Persist completed evidence before recording an overrun. A cap cannot reset on resume, and bound failure is terminal.

retention.catalog: Create a separate resumable-policy catalog only when activating the reviewed controller. Preserve original catalog/header/entries and original reference manifest byte-for-byte. Link new catalog to the same immutable reference.
retention.context_checkpoint: Require full128 numerical coverage at all3contexts, a fresh runtime handoff, every required comparison block for that context (both512blocks),20complete eligible pairs per block, all applicable complete controls passed, unchanged confidence/noise thresholds, all raw artifacts and start accounting, and valid final source/checkpoint/storage/method guards for every contributing closed epoch or sealed context boundary. At a context boundary, fully drain GPU work, close the context schedule, validate all contributing raw artifacts and identity/storage guards, then seal an immutable journal prefix and context guard receipt before later work. A context may finalize before unrelated contexts finish. Never certify an unfinished context from a live mutable state.
retention.all_context_goal: Require all3contextcertificates under this single contract, all4comparisonblocks, no failed control at any context, all numerical/guard/accounting requirements, and every block meeting the unchanged conservative5% rule. A hard-stopped or incomplete pass cannot complete the overall goal.
retention.positive_below_goal: Append every supported positive context checkpoint even below0.5%; never replace the original reference or multiply percentages from unmatched comparisons.
retention.historical_runs: Retain original statuses and policies. No old strict, interrupted or failed-control run is reclassified, and no old timing is imported into this new pass.
retention.held_out_task_quality: planned; throughput checkpoints do not certify acceptance or task quality

activation_requirements: Implement and test the production controller adapter, pre-primer atomic two-slot reservations with serialized GPU execution, raw artifact commit/recovery path, cumulative budget/watchdog and context certificate verifier against this frozen contract. The current single-start prototype does not yet implement collection reservations.
Keep exact native/candidate timing mathematics, precision and source identities; freeze the executable integration separately and verify every protected identity before launch.
Record a specific authorization for timing and its operator. The current user answer authorizes preparation/review only, not an inference launch.

Do not rerun an unchanged statistical failure merely because resumable storage exists. Declare and review a substantive new measurement hypothesis or bounded confirmation basis before any new timing allocation.
Fresh actual AC/thermal/model preflight and absence of a competing model worker; preserve every historical artifact.
